subject: Interview panel redistribution for Priya Desai - scheduling & shadow plan
messages:
From: Ben Healy <ben@talentpartners.co>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Panel scheduling: Priya Desai (SWE II)

Hi Lukas / Marissa —

Quick intro: Priya Desai is in final-stage loop for SWE II (backend) and is available Tues/Wed next week (11/23–11/24) between 10:00–16:00 PT. Hiring manager Benji asked for a 4‑interviewer loop: system design, backend implementation, debugging/coding, and bar-raiser.

We currently have folks tentatively allocated but two panelists have calendar conflicts: Nikhil has travel 11/23 and Irene is OOO 11/24. Can the team propose swaps or shadow pair options? Ideally we keep at least one interviewer with prior Redwood backend bar-raiser experience.

Attached are Priya's resume and the hiring brief. Benji asked for calendar invites to be sent by EOD Monday.

Thanks —
Ben
TalentPartners
attachments: resume_priya_desai.pdf (pdf), hiring_brief_priya.pdf (pdf)

From: lukas_meyer@redwood.com
To: Ben Healy <ben@talentpartners.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-20T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Panel scheduling: Priya Desai (SWE II)

Thanks Ben — looping the interview ops folks.

Marissa / Karthik / Soojin: quick status — current tentative panel was:
- System design: Karthik (confirm)
- Backend impl: Nikhil (travel 11/23)
- Debugging/coding: Irene (OOO 11/24)
- Bar-raiser: Marissa (confirm)

We have two options:
1) Redistribute on the same day (11/23) by swapping in shadow-able interviewers who can take half the session and shadow the other half (keeps continuity for candidate).
2) Split across two days (11/23 + 11/24) to keep subject-matter experts, but that increases candidate context switching.

My preference: Option 1 with shadow pairing. Marissa, can you take the bar-raiser slot and be paired with Soojin as shadow for backend questions if Nikhil can't make 11/23? Karthik can keep system design. If neither Nikhil nor Irene can swap, I can step into debugging/coding for one loop and recruit a peer as a shadow.

Please reply with availability blocks and whether you can be primary vs shadow. Ben — I can coordinate the calendar once we have confirmations.

-Lukas
Staffing Operations (Interviewer Coordination)
Redwood Inference

If we go with the shadowing plan, I recommend:
- 11:00–11:40 System design (Karthik primary; Lukas to monitor for timing)
- 11:45–12:25 Backend impl/debugging (Nikhil primary OR Soojin primary if Nikhil unavailable)

I've uploaded my quick availability export (attached) and a small swap matrix showing who can cover which slot if someone drops. Attaching: interviewer_availability.ics, panel_swap_matrix.xlsx.

If Lukas can send candidate calendar invites with the confirmed window, I'll prep debrief rubric and send a short calibration note to the panel (one-pager).
